Privacy.metaDescription: What data does LEIBO collect and use when you use the website.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.noAccountTitle: No account, no personal information collection
Privacy.noAccountBody: LEIBO does not require registration or login. We do not collect names, emails, or any personally identifiable information.
Privacy.themeChoiceBody: When you change the light/dark theme, it's saved with localStorage right on your browser — this data isn't sent to the server and can't be read by anyone else.
Privacy.rateLimitBody: To prevent spam/overloading, LEIBO's public APIs count calls by IP address in a short time window. This count is only temporarily stored in the server memory, not stored for a long time, not tied to any other identity.
Privacy.noAdsBody: The current site does not embed any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking tools. If this changes in the future, we will update this page again first.
Privacy.contactBody: Have privacy questions? Contact via LEIBO's community channel (see homepage).

Terms.metaDescription: Terms of use of the Genshin Impact LEIBO data lookup page.
Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.aboutBody: LEIBO is a fan-managed, non-profit, no-fee, and not officially affiliated with miHoYo/HoYoverse Genshin Impact data lookup site.
Terms.copyrightBody: All character names, weapons, holy relics, images, and game data displayed on LEIBO are copyrighted by miHoYo/HoYoverse. LEIBO only aggregates and displays for search purposes, does not claim ownership of any of those assets.
Terms.disclaimerBody: The data on LEIBO is compiled from many public sources and may not be updated in time every time the game is released, or there are errors. LEIBO is not responsible for any decisions (in-game or real-life) based on the data shown here—please check back in-game before making important decisions.
Terms.shutdownBody: LEIBO may cease operations or change content at any time without notice, as it is a non-profit project operated by the community.
Terms.takedownBody: If you are a copyright owner and would like to request the removal of specific content, please contact us via LEIBO's community channel (see homepage).

ReactionTabs.noteStandard: Anyone can activate it, no special character is needed.
ReactionTabs.noteLunar: Moonsign mechanics. Activated only when the squad has a matching Moonsign character (see "Characters" on each card).
ReactionTabs.noteStellar: It takes a character with the Vision "Stellar Linchpin" in the team to activate it, not every element is automatic.
ReactionTabs.elementalResonanceNote: There are ≥2 characters with the same element in the top 4 positions of the squad. More than 2 does not add up.
ReactionTabs.witchRevelationNote: Note: It is DIFFERENT from the Hexerei above despite the same name — this mechanism is tied to the Stellar-Conduct reaction (see the "Astral Realm" tab), not the Mondstadt faction buff.
ReactionTabs.formulaIntro: Figures sourced directly from the KeQingMains Theorycrafting Library and the official Genshin Impact Wiki, updated for the 5.2 buff to 4 reactions (Overloaded/Superconduct/Shattered/Electro-Charged). Click each source below to verify yourself.
ReactionTabs.baseCoefficientTableNote: Use this in the Transformative Reaction formula above instead. Electro-Charged can trigger twice per cycle, so actual total damage can be double the value shown below.
ReactionTabs.shatterNote: applies to the Shatter hit, not Frozen itself
